dedupe_keys.name: ised spectrum management system data extracts radio authorizations and licence sites canada

description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada publishes extracts of its Spectrum Management System, the database of the radio authorizations it issues. The Technical and Administrative Frequency List (TAFL) extracts give every authorized station with licensee, location, frequencies, bandwidth, power, antenna and service, as one All Services file (about 64 MB) compiling aeronautical, broadcast, fixed, land mobile, maritime and satellite earth station approvals, and as separate files per service; companion files list passive repeaters and reflectors and radio and antenna reference data. Spectrum licence site data extracts give the terrestrial and satellite sites that holders of auctioned spectrum licences (such as mobile operators) must report, and daily extracts support automated frequency coordination in the 6 GHz band and TV white space databases. Coverage: all of Canada, current authorizations, refreshed monthly (the extracts on the page were dated 2 September 2026). Format and access: ZIP archives of delimited text with field description PDFs, free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: authorizations are not proof of operation; mobile operators' sites under spectrum licences are reported by the licensees; field layouts differ between extracts. Simulation uses: an inventory of radio sites and microwave links for network topology and hazard exposure, and spectrum context for capacity planning. Related records: the FCC ULS and ANFR installations are counterparts, and the ISED broadcasting database covers broadcast stations.
